title: ClientSupportMatrixV1
description: MBR-206 client x operation support matrix. The matrix is the machine-readable answer to the question: 'for each declared AI/MCP client, which operations does the Membrane runtime know how to honor, and how?' It is regenerated byte-stably from schemas/registry/clients.yaml and schemas/registry/operations/operations-index.v1.golden.json by tools/productization/generate-client-matrix.mjs. The matrix is the source of truth the install path consults when deciding which clients a clean install can enroll.

matrixVersion.description: Independent version of the matrix itself; bump when the matrix shape changes.

operations.description: Operation universe mirrored from operations/operations/operations-index.v1.golden.json. The matrix must list every operation in the index.

support.description: supported = client honors the operation end-to-end; degraded = client can call it but not enforce its contract; unsupported = client cannot legitimately use the operation.

notes.description: Optional operator-facing note for the cell.

cells.description: Cartesian product of clients x operations. Every combination is present so downstream consumers can answer support questions without missing-key checks.

generatedFrom.description: Repo-relative source paths the matrix was built from. Used by stale-detection.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp the matrix was rendered; informational only.
